options.content:
# IMS Drilling Machine Detail

**Selected source:** `$machine_id` · **Mapped asset:** `DRL054-M → APEX3-F1-DRILL-054` · **Policy:** latest known status (no 15-minute expiry)

[← Apex 3 Floor 1 — 2D](/factory-twin-3d/?view=2d) · [← Apex 3 Floor 1 — 3D](/factory-twin-3d/?view=3d)

> Error rows are historical records. `machine_event` does not yet provide alarm trigger/reset lifecycle, so this dashboard does not claim any alarm is active.

panels.title: CURRENT OPERATIONAL STATE
panels.description: Latest status record for selected machine, ordered by event_time DESC then id DESC. STOP maps to Initial/PM/Stop; alarm records never force Down.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: latest known status must remain visible even when older than dashboard range. */
SELECT CASE
         WHEN event_type = 'RUN' THEN 4
         WHEN event_type = 'STOP' THEN 3
         ELSE 5
       END AS "Operational State"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND message_type = 'status'
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: LATEST STATUS TIMESTAMP
panels.description: Timestamp of source record used for current state. State remains latest-known even if timestamp is old.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: source timestamp for latest known status. */
SELECT (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM event_time) * 1000)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Last Status Time"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND message_type = 'status'
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: AGE OF LATEST STATUS
panels.description: Elapsed wall-clock time since latest status source record. Informational only; it does not expire current state.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: age is transparency metadata; it does not expire latest-known state. */
SELECT GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - event_time)), 0) AS "Seconds Since Status"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND message_type = 'status'
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: EVENT RECORDS IN RANGE
panels.description: Number of machine_event rows for selected machine and Grafana time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Event Records"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: RUN RATIO (OBSERVED)
panels.description: RUN duration divided by RUN+STOP duration inside selected range, capped at last observed event. Not vendor shift utilization.

targets.rawSql:
WITH observed AS (
  SELECT MIN(event_time) AS first_event, MAX(event_time) AS last_event
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT GREATEST($__timeFrom()::timestamptz, first_event) AS from_ts,
         LEAST($__timeTo()::timestamptz, last_event) AS to_ts
  FROM observed
),
seed AS (
  SELECT m.event_type, m.event_time, m.id
  FROM public.machine_event m
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE m.equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    AND m.message_type = 'status'
    AND m.event_time < b.from_ts
  ORDER BY m.event_time DESC, m.id DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
points AS (
  SELECT * FROM seed
  UNION ALL
  SELECT m.event_type, m.event_time, m.id
  FROM public.machine_event m
  CROSS JOIN bounds b
  WHERE m.equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    AND m.message_type = 'status'
    AND m.event_time >= b.from_ts
    AND m.event_time <= b.to_ts
),
segments AS (
  SELECT event_type,
         GREATEST(event_time, from_ts) AS segment_start,
         LEAST(LEAD(event_time, 1, to_ts) OVER (ORDER BY event_time, id), to_ts) AS segment_end
  FROM points
  CROSS JOIN bounds
),
durations AS (
  SELECT event_type,
         GREATEST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (segment_end - segment_start)), 0) AS seconds
  FROM segments
  WHERE segment_end > segment_start
)
SELECT ROUND((100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(seconds) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'RUN'), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(seconds), 0))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Run Ratio"
FROM durations

panels.title: STATUS RECORDS
panels.description: Count of status records in selected range. Same-timestamp STOP then RUN records are both retained and ordered by id.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*)::DOUBLE PRECISION AS "Status Records"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND message_type = 'status'
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)

panels.title: LATEST ERROR RECORD — HISTORICAL REFERENCE ONLY
panels.description: Latest level=E alarm record. Category, likely phase, and risk action are conservative interpretations of DG manual code families; no active lifecycle is inferred.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: latest decoded error is historical reference, never active-alarm lifecycle. */
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    AND message_type = 'alarm'
    AND level = 'E'
  ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
  LIMIT 1
), normalized AS (
  SELECT *, NULLIF(regexp_replace(event_code, '[^0-9]', '', 'g'), '')::INTEGER AS code_num
  FROM latest
)
SELECT event_time AS "Error Time",
       CASE WHEN event_code ~ '^[0-9]{4}$' THEN 'E' || event_code ELSE event_code END AS "Error Code",
       'HISTORICAL ONLY' AS "Lifecycle",
       CASE
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 101 AND 121 OR code_num = 701 THEN 'Safety / interlock'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 202 AND 324 OR code_num BETWEEN 601 AND 605 THEN 'Axis / motion'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 403 AND 419 THEN 'Spindle / tool'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 501 AND 519 THEN 'Program / tool table'
         ELSE 'Unclassified'
       END AS "Category",
       CASE
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 403 AND 419 THEN 'Tool change / measurement'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 501 AND 519 THEN 'Program selection / validation'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 202 AND 324 THEN 'Home / axis motion'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 601 AND 605 THEN 'Drilling setup / depth'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 101 AND 121 OR code_num = 701 THEN 'Startup / safety check'
         ELSE 'Unknown phase'
       END AS "Likely Phase",
       CASE
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 101 AND 121 OR code_num = 701 THEN 'STOP AND SECURE'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 403 AND 419 THEN 'STOP AND INSPECT'
         WHEN code_num BETWEEN 202 AND 324 OR code_num BETWEEN 501 AND 519 OR code_num BETWEEN 601 AND 605 THEN 'VALIDATE BEFORE RESTART'
         ELSE 'REVIEW REQUIRED'
       END AS "Risk Action",
       event_message AS "Observed Message",
       troubleshooting_method AS "Troubleshooting",
       decoder_version AS "Decoder"
FROM normalized

panels.title: OPERATIONAL STATUS HISTORY
panels.description: Last observed RUN/STOP record in each non-empty 5-minute bucket. Empty buckets remain empty and no state is extended beyond observed records; the adjacent event table retains the unaggregated rows.

targets.rawSql:
WITH sampled AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT ON (date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01'))
         date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01') AS time,
         equipment_id, event_type
  FROM public.machine_event
  WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
    AND message_type = 'status'
    AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
  ORDER BY date_bin(INTERVAL '5 minutes', event_time, TIMESTAMPTZ '1970-01-01'), event_time DESC, id DESC
)
SELECT time, equipment_id AS metric,
       CASE WHEN event_type = 'RUN' THEN 4
            WHEN event_type = 'STOP' THEN 3
            ELSE 5 END AS value
FROM sampled
ORDER BY time

panels.title: EVENT / TOOL / ALARM RECORDS
panels.description: Latest 250 source records in selected time range. Alarm rows are event history, not proof of an active alarm.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT event_time AS "Time",
       message_type AS "Type",
       event_type AS "Event",
       event_code AS "Code",
       event_message AS "Message",
       level AS "Level",
       tool_no AS "Tool",
       magazine_no AS "Magazine",
       spindle AS "Spindle"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
  AND $__timeFilter(event_time)
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 250

panels.title: SOURCE TRACEABILITY
panels.description: Latest source, ingestion, decoder, and mapping metadata. Enables trace-back without claiming data that is absent.

targets.rawSql:
/* NO_TIMEFILTER_INTENTIONAL: latest ingestion/decoder metadata for selected source. */
SELECT equipment_id AS "Machine ID",
       CASE WHEN equipment_id = 'DRL054-M' THEN 'APEX3-F1-DRILL-054' ELSE 'UNMAPPED' END AS "Layout Asset",
       source AS "Source",
       source_file AS "Source File",
       event_time AS "Latest Event",
       sent_time AS "Sent",
       received_at AS "Received",
       ROUND((1000.0 * EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (received_at - sent_time)))::NUMERIC, 1) AS "Ingestion ms",
       decode_status AS "Decode Status",
       decoder_version AS "Decoder Version",
       'LATEST_KNOWN' AS "State Policy"
FROM public.machine_event
WHERE equipment_id IN (${machine_id:singlequote})
ORDER BY event_time DESC, id DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: DATA BOUNDARY
panels.description: Explicitly documents fields unavailable in current machine_event source.

options.content:
### Not available yet

- Active alarm trigger/reset lifecycle
- Current program name and progress
- Vendor Hits / Online / Stop / Shift Rate
- Confirmed six-state values beyond RUN and STOP

Panels stay absent until a real source is provided.
